Metadata.title: Elmanian hypnosis training in Switzerland | mhp | hypnose
Metadata.description: OMNI hypnosis training in Lausanne, Geneva and Fribourg. Practise Elmanian hypnosis, book a date and pay securely by TWINT or card.

HomePage.eyebrow: OMNI Hypnosis Training Center — French-speaking Switzerland & France
HomePage.title: Elmanian hypnosis training, taught with calm precision.
HomePage.intro: mhp | hypnose is the official OMNI representative for French-speaking Switzerland and France. Direct, contemporary, solution-focused hypnosis — taught in small groups in Lausanne, Geneva and Fribourg.
HomePage.aboutTitle: A school for people who will actually practise.
HomePage.aboutBody: Founded by Marta Hegyaljai Python, mhp | hypnose brings the OMNI method into French and German-speaking practice. Groups stay small. Teaching stays practical. Recognition (ASCA, NGH, APSH, eduQua) supports a serious professional path — without turning the website into a diploma factory.
HomePage.coursesIntro: Start with the OMNI practitioner, then deepen with advanced modules. Dates and prices are published here; booking and payment happen on this site.
HomePage.whyRapidBody: Inductions are designed to reach a useful depth quickly, with tests you can actually use in the room.
HomePage.whyPracticeBody: Groups are limited to sixteen people, with an instructor and assistants, so practice is supervised rather than theoretical.
HomePage.whyNetworkBody: OMNI has taught Elmanian hypnosis since 1979. The practitioner training is the door into that community and its certifications.

CoursesPage.title: Hypnosis courses
CoursesPage.description: Foundation and advanced Elmanian hypnosis training with mhp | hypnose. Choose a course, pick a date in Switzerland, and book online.
